non_findings_and_controls: SlotHoldService checks booking.create permission and scopes active holds to identity.clinic_id; release-on-booking runs on the same DB connection/transaction path from BookingService.create. Static slice did not identify a new cross-clinic issue there.

BookingOverrideService validates day/minute/cap bounds and doctor membership; standing override edits lock overlapping rows and preserve split windows; temporary override overlap is handled by exclusion violation with a domain error.

Read services use clinic_id from StaffIdentity. WeekAppointmentsService enforces location semantics and filters DEAD_STATUSES; no new cross-tenant or booking-decision finding was confirmed in the read slice.
Existing tests cover validation and selected reader/service behavior, but there is no test in the read set for list_rules shadowed date semantics. Tests were not executed.
explicit_limitations: This is a slice audit, not a claim that the whole repository or all booking-related call chains have been read.
BookingService, FastAPI routers, UI and test coverage are targeted reads; only the five named core reader/policy services and SlotHoldService were fully read.
No runtime, API, DB, browser, VPS or production-data verification was performed.
